brief.projectTitle: IFOPSIM – Inclusive Digital Vocational Training, Cameroon
brief.title: Digital Skills. Inclusive Futures.
brief.objective: Present the concept of an inclusive digital vocational training initiative for deaf and hard-of-hearing young people in Cameroon.
brief.targetAudience: Young deaf people, educational institutions, potential project partners, and donors.
brief.mainMessage: IFOPSIM – Digital Skills. Inclusive Futures.: Presenting the concept of an inclusive, barrier-free digital vocational training lab for deaf and hard-of-hearing young people in Cameroon.
brief.imageDescription: A modern, welcoming digital learning environment featuring computers, educational technology, accessible visual learning materials, and a subtle connection to Cameroon. Strictly no people, faces, hands, or silhouettes.

textToDisplay.headline: IFOPSIM – Digital Skills. Inclusive Futures.
textToDisplay.subtitle: An inclusive vocational education initiative in development.

approvedLogo.disclaimer: Offizielles TEFA e.V. Verbands-Brandmark (genehmigt nach Satzung).

typographyGuidance.styleTone: Modern, welcoming, professional, realistic, environmentally conscious

brandIdentity.visualComposition: Modern digital vocational classroom in Douala Cameroon with accessible computer workstations, visual sign language learning charts, tropical plants, solar backup unit, warm sunlight, zero humans.
brandIdentity.coreVisualSubject: Accessible digital vocational training laboratory for deaf and hard-of-hearing learners in Cameroon

masterVisual.promptUsed: Modern welcoming digital vocational training classroom concept in Cameroon designed for inclusive education for deaf and hard-of-hearing learners. Wooden desks with open laptop computers displaying accessible visual interfaces and graphic learning materials, tablet stands with colorful visual study charts, large chalkboard with clean diagrams, subtle Douala Cameroon architectural accents, warm natural tropical sunlight through windows, lush green indoor plants, clean solar-battery power unit mounted neatly in background. Strictly NO people, NO human figures, NO faces, NO human silhouettes, NO hands, NO crowds.
masterVisual.negativePrompt: people, person, human, face, silhouette, hand, crowd, messy, distorted logos, unrealistic technology

brief.title: Generation Green – Small Actions, Big Change
brief.objective: Inspire young people to engage in environmental protection, sustainability, and practical green innovation.
brief.targetAudience: Young people, educational institutions, potential project partners, and donors.
brief.mainMessage: Generation Green – Small Actions, Big Change: Empowering youth through practical environmental protection, clean solar technology, and sustainable green innovation.
brief.imageDescription: A small green plant growing from a recycled computer motherboard, surrounded by subtle solar-energy and environmental design elements bathed in warm sunlight.
